title: Polynomial Identity Testing to Zero Testing
statement: For every bit string $x$, $x$ encodes a pair of well-formed algebraic circuits on the same number of variables computing equal polynomials if and only if the zero-testing instance produced from $x$ belongs to the language of encodings of well-formed algebraic circuits that compute the zero polynomial.
caveat: The statement depends on a specific transformation to a zero-testing instance, but the supplied definitions do not describe that transformation.
